# reflection. d_true: |S - S| with the mirror that is behind the ray; d_word: with what the previous-medium word

# diag: mirror behind, every path. One ray, every reflected and transmitted ray followed until it is in air, dead
# or 20 events old, summed at the polyline's point, against the matrix of the wall (HSH: against the run at
# eps 0 with 60 events), dB. lib: the library at eps 0.15; inh: eps 1.5 on every leg that began at a declined
# reflection; true: the mirror written into the word after a declined reflection at a bare face; res: eps 0.
# n: the paths behind and in front of the wall, lib. sum: the events on a leg that began at a declined reflection
# and summed a series, lib; worth: the largest of them, dB; sum_true: the same count with the word made true.
# cut: the rays stopped at 20 events, lib
